NSPR-4.35

Introduction to NSPR

Netscape Portable Runtime provides a platform-neutral API.

Package Information

  • Download (HTTP): https://archive.mozilla.org/pub/nspr/releases/v4.35/src/nspr-4.35.tar.gz

  • Download (FTP): ftp://ftp.mozilla.org/pub/nspr/releases/v4.35/src/nspr-4.35.tar.gz

  • Download MD5 sum: 5be51b4a3607b0c2a3b6a0e1b1a1e7ad

  • Download size: 1.1 MB

  • Estimated disk space required: 24 MB

NSPR Dependencies

Required: Zlib-1.2.13 and libffi-3.4.4

Recommended: SQLite-3.40.1

Optional: Doxygen-1.9.6, Cyrus SASL and Electric Fence

Installation of NSPR

Install NSPR by running the following commands:

cd nspr &&
sed -ri 's#^(RELEASE_BINS =).*#\1#' config/rules.mk &&
./configure --prefix=/usr --with-mozilla

This package does not come with a test suite.

Now, as the root user:

make install

Kernel Configuration

Enable the following options in the kernel configuration and recompile:

Device Drivers --->
  <*/M> Sound card support --->                  [CONFIG_SOUND]
    <*/M> Advanced Linux Sound Architecture ---> [CONFIG_SND]
File systems --->
  <*/M> Second extended fs support              [CONFIG_EXT2_FS]
